hook: Pairing single ruthenium atoms with chromium slows their dissolution 55.7-fold in acidic water splitting.
hook_turn: slows their dissolution 55.7-fold in acidic water splitting.

readout.label: Gain in resistance to Ru dissolution vs SACs

summary: Atomically dispersed Ru-O-Cr units damp ruthenium oxidation during acidic oxygen evolution, as seen by in situ X-ray absorption. In membrane electrolyzers at 1 A per cm2, degradation was 6.8 times lower than for Ru single-atom catalysts and 14.4 times lower than for commercial RuO2. The authors call it a possible design principle, and long-term durability beyond these tests is not shown.
title: Proximal redox coupling enables oxidation damping for stable water electrolysis.
